I'm sorry about the wait, that's frustrating. Refunds are due within 5 business days of the return reaching our warehouse, to your original payment method. Since I can't see your return's status from here, I can't tell whether the clock started when you dropped it off or when it arrived.

If your tracking shows it was delivered to us more than 5 business days ago, the refund is overdue, and I can escalate it to a Support Lead. Could you tell me the delivery date on the tracking? You can also email help@leafy.example, which is answered within 1 business day.
